You will investigate and resolve complex, escalated payment-related complaints, prepare formal responses, and help turn challenging user situations into fair, well-managed outcomes. This role sits within the Vinted Pay Customer Support organisation, part of Vinted Pay - Vinted’s expanding regulated financial services entity. The team works in a hybrid setup, with 3 days per week expected in the office to support close collaboration and effective cross-functional work for a newly building team.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for high-priority, complex, or escalated payment-related complaints requiring specialist handling.</li> <li>Investigate complaints thoroughly and make fair, evidence-based decisions, balancing customer outcomes, company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational risk.</li> <li>Prepare clear, accurate, and well-reasoned complaint responses in line with applicable UK and Lithuanian regulatory expectations, including FCA DISP, Consumer Duty, GDPR, FOS, and Bank of Lithuania standards.</li> <li>Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, senior management, and external partners, to resolve complex customer issues.</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by translating complaint themes and pain points into actionable insights for Product, Policy, Risk, and Operations teams.</li> <li>Use complaint data and root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues, emerging risks, and opportunities for service improvement.</li> &lt
